summary: Hagerty, Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing a secondary offering by selling stockholder Hagerty Holding Corp., which sold 10,637,500 Class A shares at $11.95 per share after underwriters Wells Fargo and J.P. Morgan exercised in full their 30-day option for 1,387,500 additional shares, closing September 11, 2026. The company registered the shares under an existing shelf and issued a pricing press release; no primary proceeds accrue to Hagerty. This is an ordinary registered shelf takedown by an existing holder, not a special situation, though monitoring float expansion and overhang post-lockup is warranted.
